Business model preserved in code: companies have active CoveragePlan rows; riders register with company_id and zone_id. The payout_per_day plan rate is enforced as a remaining daily limit by backend/app/services/coverage_cap.py. It is not a rider-purchased policy.

This traffic-analysis lane is separate from the claim decision. Six saved claim checkpoints show review progress to the rider.
